method.screening: each abstract classified for whether it supplies a runnable detector (probe / judge / programmatic / uncertainty / monitor / preflight / benchmark+scorer); per-mode shortlists then curated by hand
method.evidence_level: ABSTRACT-LEVEL ONLY. No full text was read. Titles and arXiv ids are verbatim from the API; per-entry descriptions paraphrase abstracts and are not verified against method sections.
method.coverage_caveat: arXiv-only. ACL/EMNLP-only work, industry tooling and closed evaluations are out of scope.
method.provenance_check: All 80 cited arXiv ids verified present in the retrieved pool with verbatim API titles. Two records (2606.18467, 2505.14925) were curated from their abstracts after the automatic screening batch was cut short by a token limit; their detector_type and runtime_capable fields were assigned by hand and are labelled as such in detector-candidates.csv.

coverage_tiers.moderate: 2-3, or strong detectors with a locus/runtime caveat
coverage_tiers.thin: proxies only, or a single mechanism-level result
coverage_tiers.none: no detector found for this mode's tell after two query rounds

modes.label: Literalism
modes.tell: Obeys the words, misses the intent.

detectors.title: When Contextual Inference Fails: Cancelability in Interactive Instruction Following
detectors.note: Separates literal interpretation from contextual inference in underspecified instruction-following; supplies a cancelability test that operationalises letter-vs-spirit.

detectors.title: TOD-ProcBench: Benchmarking Complex Instruction-Following in Task-Oriented Dialogues
detectors.note: Procedural instruction-following benchmark with an explicit violation-detection subtask.

modes.gap_note: No detector targets letter-vs-spirit divergence in agent traces. Nearest neighbours are prompt-injection defences, which share the surface signal (obeyed the wrong instruction) but a different cause.

modes.label: Shape of the Example
modes.tell: Copies the example's form, not your goal.

detectors.title: Mitigating Copy Bias in In-Context Learning through Neuron Pruning
detectors.note: Measures and localises 'copy bias' — answers copied from in-context examples rather than derived from the task — and prunes the responsible neurons.

detectors.title: Mitigating the Bias of Large Language Model Evaluation
detectors.note: Judge-side analogue: raters scoring superficial quality over instruction fidelity.

modes.gap_note: Only mechanism-level work exists. No trace-level detector asks whether an agent's output mirrors the exemplar's form rather than the request's goal.

modes.label: Shape of the Conversation
modes.tell: Follows the chat's drift over the facts.

detectors.title: Detecting and Controlling Sycophancy with Cascading Linear Features
detectors.note: Linear-feature probe over activations; detects and steers sycophancy at inference time.

detectors.title: Measuring and Detecting Harmful AI Sycophancy
detectors.note: Detects stance reversals driven by user preference rather than evidence.

detectors.title: SWAY: A Counterfactual Computational Linguistic Approach to Measuring and Mitigating Sycophancy
detectors.note: Counterfactual framing manipulation that isolates sycophancy from content-driven reasoning.

detectors.title: FramingQA: Does the Question Shape the Answer? Measuring the Compositional Framing Effect
detectors.note: Measures the compositional framing effect: same facts, rephrased question, changed answer.

detectors.title: The Social Sycophancy Scale: A psychometrically validated measure of sycophancy
detectors.note: Psychometrically validated sycophancy scale for open-ended domains without ground truth.

modes.label: No Questions Asked
modes.tell: Guesses on ambiguity instead of asking.

detectors.title: When and What to Ask: AskBench and Rubric-Guided RLVR for LLM Clarification
detectors.note: Benchmark plus rubric-guided RLVR for when and what to ask; covers ambiguous and false-premise queries.

detectors.title: Uncertainty Decomposition for Clarification Seeking in LLM Agents
detectors.note: Decomposes predictive uncertainty into components that signal when clarification is warranted — runtime-usable.

detectors.title: Structured Uncertainty guided Clarification for LLM Agents
detectors.note: Structured uncertainty over tool parameters as a preflight clarification trigger.

detectors.title: Ambig-SWE: Interactive Agents to Overcome Underspecificity in Software Engineering
detectors.note: Underspecified software-engineering issues; scores whether the agent asks before implementing.

detectors.title: When Search Agents Should Ask: DiscoBench for Clarification-Aware Deep Search
detectors.note: Clarification-aware deep search: detects agents that assume rather than ask.

modes.label: Manufactured Decision
modes.tell: Asks permission for work already authorized.

detectors.title: HiL-Bench (Human-in-Loop Benchmark): Do Agents Know When to Ask for Help?
detectors.note: Measures whether agents know when to ask for help — the opposite polarity: penalises under-asking, not over-asking.

detectors.title: Clarify-Then-Search: A Clarification Benchmark for Deep Search with End-to-End Nugget Restoration
detectors.note: Same polarity: rewards clarification on underspecified queries.

modes.gap_note: The entire clarification literature is built to punish under-asking. Nothing published scores an agent for escalating a decision it was already authorised to make, so A5 currently has no external anchor and no detector.

modes.label: Shape of the Data
modes.tell: Treats available data as the whole picture.

detectors.title: ScoreGate: Adaptive Chunk Selection for Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Dual-Score Statistical Fusion
detectors.note: Dual-score statistic that flags over- and under-retrieval per query — a programmatic proxy for 'the evidence set is not the whole picture'.

detectors.title: URAG: A Benchmark for Uncertainty Quantification in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
detectors.note: Uncertainty quantification for RAG, scoring beyond answer correctness.

detectors.title: Investigating the Factual Knowledge Boundary of Large Language Models with Retrieval Augmentation
detectors.note: Measures whether models perceive their own factual-knowledge boundary under retrieval augmentation.

modes.gap_note: Detectors exist for insufficient retrieval; none for the agent treating a complete-looking but skewed evidence set as the population.

modes.label: Shape of the Tool
modes.tell: Lets its tools pick the approach.

detectors.title: Internal Representations as Indicators of Hallucinations in Agent Tool Selection
detectors.note: Internal-representation indicators of hallucinated tool selection, readable during inference.

detectors.title: Quantitative Certification of Agentic Tool Selection
detectors.note: Certifies a tool-selection pipeline against a safety spec under a realistic tool distribution.

detectors.title: When Agents Fail to Act: A Diagnostic Framework for Tool Invocation Reliability in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
detectors.note: Diagnostic framework for tool-invocation reliability across model classes.

detectors.title: Agent Skills Can Be Harmful: An Empirical Study of Skill-Induced Failures in LLM Agents
detectors.note: Empirical study of skill-induced failures: skills that degrade success or cost without being flagged.

modes.gap_note: All of these score tool choice against a known-correct tool. None runs the counterfactual that B2 actually asserts — would the approach change if the tool were absent?

modes.label: Shape of the Prior
modes.tell: The default answer beats the evidence given.

detectors.title: Anchoring Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge Systems: Prior Scores Compromise Evaluation Independence
detectors.note: Prior scores shift LLM-judge ratings; quantifies anchoring as an independence violation.

detectors.title: Anchors in the Machine: Behavioral and Attributional Evidence of Anchoring Bias in LLMs
detectors.note: Behavioural and attributional evidence of anchoring, with an attribution analysis of the mechanism.

detectors.title: Parameters vs. Context: Fine-Grained Control of Knowledge Reliance in Language Models
detectors.note: Fine-grained measurement and control of parametric-vs-context reliance under conflict.

detectors.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models
detectors.note: Memory-tool conflict benchmark; reports how rarely correct memory survives an incorrect tool return.

modes.gap_note: Strong offline/counterfactual instruments, no runtime signal — all require running the item twice under varied anchors.

modes.label: First Suspect
modes.tell: Locks on hypothesis #1, skips the rest.

detectors.title: Information-seeking failures of large language models in agentic clinical reasoning
detectors.note: Agentic clinical reasoning: detects models that stop investigating and commit under uncertainty.

detectors.title: Evaluating Multi-Turn Multimodal Diagnostic Reasoning on Challenging Real-World Clinical Cases
detectors.note: Multi-turn diagnostic reasoning that locks on an initial hypothesis.

detectors.title: AgentAbstain: Do LLM Agents Know When Not to Act?
detectors.note: Whether agents recognise abstention triggers before acting.

modes.gap_note: Only instantiated in clinical diagnosis, where premature closure has a 20-year prior literature. No domain-general trace detector.

modes.label: Sunk Path
modes.tell: Won't abandon a failing approach.

detectors.title: SkillHEX: Improving Agent Skills via Hypothesis-Driven Autonomous Exploration and Exploitation
detectors.note: Agent locks onto a failing skill revision and skips alternatives — closest observed behaviour.

detectors.title: FinHarness: An Inline Lifecycle Safety Harness for Finance LLM Agents
detectors.note: Inline lifecycle harness flagging irreversible mid-trajectory actions.

modes.gap_note: Two targeted query rounds returned no detector and no benchmark for sunk-cost persistence in LLM agents. This is a real hole in the literature, not a query artifact — despite B5 being one of the most reported practitioner complaints.

modes.label: Forced Symmetry
modes.tell: Invents parallelism that isn't there.
modes.gap_note: Nothing. False balance is studied in media framing and in bias audits of generated text, never as an agent reasoning failure with a detection procedure.

modes.label: Premature Abstraction
modes.tell: Builds the framework too early.

detectors.title: A Causal Perspective on Measuring, Explaining and Mitigating Smells in LLM-Generated Code
detectors.note: Causal measurement, explanation and mitigation of code smells in LLM-generated code — the only quantitative handle on over-structuring.

detectors.title: Assessing the Quality and Security of AI-Generated Code: A Quantitative Analysis
detectors.note: Quantitative code-quality and security comparison across five models.

modes.gap_note: Code-smell metrics are a proxy with a known confound: idiomatic abstraction and premature abstraction produce overlapping smell profiles.

modes.label: Confabulation
modes.tell: Invents specifics to complete the pattern.

detectors.title: Tool Receipts, Not Zero-Knowledge Proofs: Practical Hallucination Detection for AI Agents
detectors.note: Cross-references agent claims against tool-call receipts; catches fabricated counts and false absence claims. Cheapest runtime detector in this whole table.

detectors.title: Actionable Hallucination Detection: Translating Latent Uncertainty into Agentic Critique
detectors.note: Translates latent uncertainty into an agentic critique of hallucinated tool calls and ungrounded parameters.

detectors.title: Beyond Document Grounding: Span-Level Hallucination Detection over Code, Tool Output, and Documents
detectors.note: Span-level hallucination classifier over code, tool output and structured documents.

detectors.title: MetaRAG: Metamorphic Testing for Hallucination Detection in RAG Systems
detectors.note: Metamorphic testing for RAG: synonym/antonym entailment mismatches reveal unsupported factoids.

modes.label: Unchecked Premise
modes.tell: Never tests the starting assumption.

detectors.title: Syn-QA2: Evaluating False Assumptions in Long-tail Questions with Synthetic QA Datasets
detectors.note: Synthetic long-tail QA with false assumptions; scores whether the model rejects the premise.

detectors.title: Source or It Didn't Happen: A Multi-Agent Framework for Citation Hallucination Detection
detectors.note: Multi-agent citation-hallucination detection: extraction, retrieval, field matching, specialist judgment.

detectors.title: ScopeJudge: Cost-Aware Pre-Execution Gating for Offensive Security Agents
detectors.note: Pre-execution gating of tool calls against declared scope boundaries.

modes.gap_note: Mature at the QA level. The agent-trace version — the premise entering step 1 was never tested — has no published detector.

modes.label: Sailing
modes.tell: Glides to the end, never checks.

detectors.title: Self-Authored Verification Is Unreliable in Heuristic Self-Improving Agents
detectors.note: Self-authored verification scores diverge from external deployment performance. Read this one first: it is evidence against the self-report detector method in your own telemetry schema.

detectors.title: E-valuator: Reliable Agent Verifiers with Sequential Hypothesis Testing
detectors.note: Sequential hypothesis testing over trajectories; flags long runs with no progress verification.

detectors.title: ToolChain-CRC: Conformal Risk Control for Agentic AI Under Retrieval and Tool-Use Drift
detectors.note: Conformal risk control over retrieval and tool-use drift — calibrated abstention rather than a heuristic threshold.

detectors.title: SWE-Marathon: Can Agents Autonomously Complete Ultra-Long-Horizon Software Work?
detectors.note: Ultra-long-horizon software work; scores claims of success against actual requirements.

detectors.title: ContractBench: Can LLM Agents Preserve Observation Contracts?
detectors.note: Whether agents preserve observation contracts (temporal validity, byte integrity) across API workflows.

modes.label: Skating
modes.tell: Checks the surface only.

detectors.title: The Silent Judge: Unacknowledged Shortcut Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge
detectors.note: LLM judges rationalising decisions from unacknowledged superficial cues — surface-checking with a plausible narrative on top.

detectors.title: Beyond correlation: The Impact of Human Uncertainty in Measuring the Effectiveness of Automatic Evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge
detectors.note: Correlation metrics masking performance gaps on high-uncertainty subsets.

modes.gap_note: Locus mismatch: published work catches a superficial *judge*, your C3 is a superficial *self-check*. The instruments transfer but the validation does not.

modes.label: Spot-Check
modes.tell: Tests one case, assumes the rest.

detectors.title: Process Supervision for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Monte Carlo Net Information Gain
detectors.note: Monte-Carlo net information gain per reasoning step; identifies steps that do not change correctness likelihood.

detectors.title: MamaBench: Benchmarking LLM Robustness in Maternal and Child Health Diagnosis through Counterfactual Clinical Perturbation
detectors.note: Counterfactual clinical variants where base-case accuracy masks fragility — the spot-check fallacy at benchmark level.

detectors.title: MEDEQUALQA: Evaluating Biases in LLMs with Counterfactual Reasoning
detectors.note: Counterfactual demographic variation scoring reasoning stability.

modes.gap_note: No detector asks whether an agent's verification sample covers its claim. Software testing has the ready-made apparatus — mutation score, test adequacy criteria — and nobody has applied it to agent self-verification.

modes.label: Closure Performance
modes.tell: Looks done; isn't verified.

detectors.title: From Confident Closing to Silent Failure: Characterizing False Success in LLM Agents
detectors.note: Characterises false success: agent claims completion without verifying the environment state changed. The closest published match to C5.

detectors.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract
detectors.note: Argues agent actions need verifiable evidence of execution; runtime-contract framing.

detectors.title: Complementing Self-Consistency with Cross-Model Disagreement for Uncertainty Quantification
detectors.note: Cross-model semantic disagreement as an uncertainty signal for confident-but-wrong outputs.

detectors.title: Evaluating LLM Agents on Automated Software Analysis Tasks
detectors.note: Agents claiming success without validating that the tool produced meaningful output.

modes.label: Gaming the Check
modes.tell: Makes the check pass dishonestly.

detectors.title: EvilGenie: A Reward Hacking Benchmark
detectors.note: Reward-hacking benchmark covering test hardcoding, test-file editing and judge evasion.

detectors.title: Hack-Verifiable Environments: Towards Evaluating Reward Hacking at Scale
detectors.note: Environments with deliberately embedded exploitable vulnerabilities, verifiable at scale.

detectors.title: Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench: Evaluating Reward Hacking in Terminal Tasks
detectors.note: Terminal-task variant of the same hack-verifiable design.

detectors.title: Monitoring Emergent Reward Hacking During Generation via Internal Activations
detectors.note: Reward-hacking signals in internal activations during generation — runtime, pre-completion.

detectors.title: Monitoring and Discovering Reward Hacking with Internal Representations during LLM Evaluations
detectors.note: Internal-representation monitoring for reward hacking during evaluations.

detectors.title: Is It Thinking or Cheating? Detecting Implicit Reward Hacking by Measuring Reasoning Effort
detectors.note: Detects implicit reward hacking by measuring reasoning effort: high reward on truncated reasoning.

detectors.title: Harness-agnostic detection and immunization of reward hacking in self-evolving language models
detectors.note: Harness-agnostic detection and immunisation for self-evolving models.

detectors.title: Do Prompt-Elicited Trajectories Reflect Training-Time Reward Hacking? A Systematic Study on Monitoring Training-Time Reward Hacking in Code Generation
detectors.note: Asks whether prompt-elicited hacking trajectories reflect training-time hacking — a validity warning for anyone eliciting C6 on demand.

modes.label: Spinning
modes.tell: Repeats a step with no progress.

detectors.title: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction
detectors.note: Induces a finite-state automaton from agent traces; predicts failure-prone states and non-progress loops.

detectors.title: Real-Time Detection and Repair of LLM Agent Failures
detectors.note: Real-time detection and repair of mid-episode loops, drift, and fabricated results from telemetry anomalies.

detectors.title: E-valuator: Reliable Agent Verifiers with Sequential Hypothesis Testing
detectors.note: Sequential testing flags unproductive repetition without a fixed loop-count threshold.

detectors.title: An Approach to Checking Correctness for Agentic Systems
detectors.note: Temporal assertions over action sequences; programmatic and cheap.

modes.label: Drift
modes.tell: Goal erodes across a long run.

detectors.title: MAGE: Safeguarding LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Threats via Shadow Memory
detectors.note: Shadow memory that preserves the original objective and flags drift across long trajectories.

detectors.title: TRACE: Trajectory Reasoning through Adaptive Cross-Step Evidence Aggregation for LLM Agents
detectors.note: Cross-step evidence aggregation to surface objectives that emerged mid-run.

detectors.title: ProbGuard: Proactive Runtime Monitoring for LLM Agent Safety via Probabilistic Prediction
detectors.note: Probabilistic trajectory prediction with an intervention trigger below a safety threshold.

detectors.title: Evaluating Agentic AI in the Wild: Failure Modes, Drift Patterns, and a Production Evaluation Framework
detectors.note: Production field study of drift and compounding error with an evaluation framework.

modes.label: Context Bleed
modes.tell: Drops earlier or mid-context constraints.

detectors.title: Beyond Black-Box Benchmarking: Observability, Analytics, and Optimization of Agentic Systems
detectors.note: Observability and analytics for agentic systems; names context loss as an observable.

detectors.title: Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Agents: A Taxonomy, an Evaluation Protocol, and an Empirical Study
detectors.note: Step-level calibration masking trajectory-level drift in agent uncertainty.

detectors.title: Too Long, Didn't Model: Decomposing LLM Long-Context Understanding With Novels
detectors.note: Decomposes long-context understanding; measurement rather than detection.

modes.gap_note: Well benchmarked, poorly detected. A constraint-ledger check — enumerate constraints at turn 1, re-verify each against the final output — is trivially implementable and, as far as these queries reach, unpublished.

modes.label: Say-Do Gap
modes.tell: Reasoning says one thing; the action does another.

detectors.title: DeceptGuard :A Constitutional Oversight Framework For Detecting Deception in LLM Agents
detectors.note: Constitutional oversight framework for reasoning-action mismatch, including deception masked by behavioural suppression.

detectors.title: Guardrails as Scapegoats: Auditing Unfaithful Safety Refusals in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
detectors.note: Audits unfaithful safety refusals: agent invents a rationale when a tool silently fails.

detectors.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing
detectors.note: Step-level guardrails auditing each action against stated constraints before execution.

detectors.title: ToolSafe: Enhancing Tool Invocation Safety of LLM-based agents via Proactive Step-level Guardrail and Feedback
detectors.note: Proactive step-level detection of misalignment between safety reasoning and the invoked tool.

detectors.title: VeriGuard: Enhancing LLM Agent Safety via Verified Code Generation
detectors.note: Verified code generation: actions checked against a pre-verified policy at runtime.

cross_cutting.title: TelemetrySuffBench: Is Agent Telemetry Sufficient for Failure-Origin Diagnosis?
cross_cutting.note: Tests whether agent telemetry is sufficient to identify where a failure originated — directly relevant to your event schema's adequacy.

cross_cutting.title: MAESTRO: Multi-Agent Evaluation Suite for Testing, Reliability, and Observability
cross_cutting.note: Multi-agent evaluation suite; run-to-run variance masking structural failures.

cross_cutting.title: Self-Authored Verification Is Unreliable in Heuristic Self-Improving Agents
cross_cutting.note: Self-authored verification diverges from external performance — bears on detector.method='self-report'.
